bio: Sivuun harnesses the Shadewall, able to wield its moonlight even in the brilliance of day. Her magic can preserve the Dusklit under the glaring sun… and can also call the moon’s wrath down on her enemies no matter where they hide. She heals with one hand, and destroys with the other.
